title: Nonlinear rank-band shape audit of the active SONAR ranking

hypothesis.null: Conditional on all information available before target t, the five target numbers map to a uniformly random 5-subset of the 40 ranks. After removing the linear rank trend, the eight consecutive 5-rank bands have no systematic shape departure.
hypothesis.alternative: The active SONAR ranking induces a reproducible nonlinear rank-band shape: rank-band counts depart from the uniform 5-of-40 null even after removing the linear mean-rank component.
hypothesis.estimand: For each split, aggregate counts C_b of actual numbers in rank bands [1-5],[6-10],...,[36-40]. Let x_b=C_b-0.625*T, l_b=band_center_b-20.5, beta=(x·l)/(l·l), r=x-beta*l. The nonlinear shape statistic is Q=sum_b(r_b^2)/(T*175/312).
hypothesis.direction: Two-sided shape departure represented by the upper tail of Q; linear rank trend is projected out and separately addressed by Q100.

splits.rule: Reuse Q100's frozen chronological split; no target or cutoff changes.

exact_conditional_null.per_target_draw: Uniform 5-subset of 40 ranks, independent conditional on the pre-target history under the lottery null.
exact_conditional_null.inference: Monte Carlo conditional randomization by sampling 5 distinct ranks from 1..40 for each target; compute the same residualized Q. Fixed seed 0x5100A101; 20000 replicates; add-one upper-tail p-value.

inference.primary_endpoint: Residualized nonlinear rank-band shape Q on historical Blind OOS (641 targets).
inference.discovery_validation: Descriptive split comparisons only; no parameter selection and no independent confirmatory claims.
inference.multiple_testing: Bonferroni ×43 as a conservative screen for the catalogued SONAR configuration family; this does not cover unknown analyst degrees of freedom. One primary statistic is used; no per-band post-hoc tests.
inference.uncertainty: Report observed residualized band profile and conditional-null Monte Carlo p-value. No stationarity claim.

integrity_checks: Q100 source ledger blob SHA matches the pinned Git blob.
All 3203 ledger targets reconcile to canonical archive target index, date, prior-day cutoff, max training outcome index and actual quintet.
All 3203 rank vectors contain five distinct integers in 1..40.
Recompute rank sum, mean rank, Top5/Top10/Top20 and all eight band counts from draw_ranks and reconcile to the ledger.
Recompute discovery/validation/historical blind split assignment from frozen ordinal boundaries.
Conditional null simulation uses only the fixed 5-of-40 rank subset law and a fixed deterministic seed.
Replay with the same seed returns identical extreme counts and p-value.
guardrails: This is a post-hoc diagnostic of Q100's already exposed historical rank ledger, not a virgin holdout or independent predictive validation.
No engine weights, ranking, forecasts or prospective freezes are changed.
No target outcome or future data is used to construct the source forecasts; Q101 only audits the Q100 prior-only ledger.
No automatic model promotion, merge or production change; human review required.
next_action: If no stable nonlinear shape departure is found, stop retrospective rank-shape tuning and continue Q60 append-only prospective collection. Do not score the 2026-11-10 pending freezes until the official result is verified and appended to the canonical archive.
